description: Edge case: no factors available. availableCount=0, so confidence is 0.0, the performance score is 0.0 (totalWeight=0 short-circuits to 0.0 instead of producing NaN), and the below_performance_threshold flag does NOT fire because its check is guarded by `availableCount > 0`. Pins the 'no data' state as distinct from the 'poor performance' state — a validator with no data is not put on probation.
